title: Ultrafilter Extensions for Veltman Semantics
summary: In this paper, we present a first-order frame condition for interpretability logic and show that the condition is not modally definable. Yet, the frame condition holds both on ILM and on ILP frames and, hence, is of potential importance for the long-standing open problem about the interpretability logic of all reasonable arithmetical theories. In the light of the Goldblatt-Thomason Theorem, the modally inexpressible frame condition serves as motivation to develop ultrafilter extensions for interpretability logic. We develop the necessary algebraic tools to define these ultrafilter extensions…
